verdict: Stop serial identical us-central1-a T4 retries. Keep CPU as routine research path; use occasional placement-flexible GPU extraction with immutable cache reuse. Do not force the full frozen GLM job onto CPU or reject the information family from a resource error.

cache_contract.caveat: Current Bank binds complete hybrid policy as well as exact features/views/DNA/model. Downstream changes compatible with those identities may reuse; future head-policy or depth changes need explicit tested compatibility/rebind, never manifest edits or fallback. New DNA/crops/model/tokenizer/pooling/precision require fresh declared features.

proposal.approval: RESOURCE_EXCEPTIONS_REQUIRED; existing $45 is not permission for new VM/zone/disks/GPU model
proposal.scope: One temporary extraction-only GPU worker plus original E2 for verified staging/CPU head/downstream. Same frozen two-community E021 comparison, no additional treatment.
proposal.quota: Only if L4 selected: balanced-disk quota at least 404 GiB (original 300 plus temporary 104). Global/T4/L4 GPU quota already 1; recheck usage and CPU quotas. No new service/IAM.
proposal.cleanup_first: Before requesting/provisioning storage, bounded original-E2 inventory must measure df/du and classify disposable files. Last accepted space fits proposed original-node work; the new disks solve cross-zone placement, not original-disk fullness. Safe cleanup cannot make a zonal disk attach in another zone or make pd-standard valid for G2.
proposal.transport: Plan: bounded encrypted source-node -> Mac -> worker input stream and worker -> Mac -> original-node complete-bank stream via pinned SSH/IAP. Fixed small buffers, no bulk DNA/cache retained on Mac, no credentials copied, no public listener or IAM/service expansion. Price WAN data honestly; do not call it internal free transfer. Avoid bulk GCS staging and its seven-day soft-delete tail.
proposal.source_delivery: Exact clean shallow source/wheel/model payload from Mac; do not copy SSH/GitHub credentials to worker.
proposal.cache_lifetime: Preserve complete new banks on original disk after verified transfer; preserve every journal. No partial-bank resume or accepted-science replay. Delete only authorized disposable worker/disks after originals/cache/logs are retained and verified; finish before original October28 boundary.
proposal.retention: No extension. Disk 96-hour factor is a conservative price upper, not authorization to keep past October28. Source/refined outputs remain on original retained disk.
proposal.native_status: UNADMITTED: no portable native launcher or Linux/CUDA/driver/transfer/scale gates have passed. Implement/test freeze before launch; source/precision/schedule/views/grouping/evaluator unchanged.

quotes.meaning: Conservative gross upper estimates at current prices, not observed invoice or speed claim. 38.25 GPU/8.25 CPU stop bounds, 96h costing of temporary 104GiB disks, 48.25h original-disk attribution, 22GiB outbound, operations and contingency. Refresh before launch; stop above $45 or unclear coverage.

serious_alternatives.same_zone_retries: Deprioritized after five visible exhausted-pool errors; no new identical call in this task
serious_alternatives.pure_CPU: Continue compact CPU architecture, code/tests, cached learners/grouping. Not automatic full GLM extraction; rough price/time conflicts with current envelope.
serious_alternatives.same_zone_V100: Regional quota exists but ~$2.865/h including VM/IP; do not substitute speculatively. No availability or full runtime proof.
serious_alternatives.reservation: Not a remedy creating unavailable physical capacity; billed idle capacity and commitments are a separate spending decision.
serious_alternatives.other_GPU_providers: May help later but current Welcome credits do not fund unrelated vendors; no unapproved real-money fallback.
serious_alternatives.larger_architecture: No change now. Frozen extraction is the outstanding information experiment; GPU scheduling does not determine model families.

sources.finding: Request-specific physical capacity failures are distinct from quota. Alternate configuration or placement is a supported remedy; no pool is guaranteed.
Iowa catalogs G2/L4 in a,b,c; N1/T4 in a,b,c,f. Catalog support is not free capacity.
g2-standard-8 has 8 vCPU, 32 GiB RAM and one 24 GiB L4. G2 does not support the original pd-standard boot type.
Zonal PD cannot be attached across zones. Standard PD favors sequential IO; retain random-access head fitting on original balanced disk.
Ordinary T4 GPU is $0.35/hour; ordinary V100 $2.48/hour before VM/IP. L4 cost included in G2 whole-VM pricing; Catalog component sum used without DWS/vWS.
Conservative North America-to-Europe first paid tier $0.12/GiB; do not assume free offsets. Streaming via Mac is charged outbound transport.
Paid upgrade retains unused Welcome credit for covered products. Recheck product scope/balance/pending usage; no Marketplace/vWS/commitments or uncovered cost.
Sections 4.2/4.3 distinguish paid-upgrade retained credits from non-billable-trial restrictions.
